template.title: Lily and the Hummingbird in the Garden
template.summary: Lily helps a shy hummingbird find its way, learning kindness and patience.

sentences.text_with_blanks: [[slot_child]] loved to play in the backyard garden.
One sunny morning, [[slot_child]] saw a [[slot_pet]] hopping near a [[slot_flower]].
The [[slot_pet]] was shy, and a tiny hummingbird was stuck in the petals.
The hummingbird tried to fly, but it couldn't get out.
She gathered a soft [[slot_nest_material]] and made a little nest.
The hummingbird rested, and its feathers shone like a [[slot_feather_color]] star.
Soon, the hummingbird was ready to fly again.
It fluttered out of the flower, thanked [[slot_child]] with a bright chirp, and disappeared.
Later, a single [[slot_feather_color]] feather fell to the ground, and [[slot_child]] placed it on the garden bench.
